column3: Exact repetition identifies the purified servants who are excepted from the surrounding punishment and false descriptions.
Repentance, repair, holding fast to God, and purifying religion describe the allegiance embodied by God's purified servants.
Exact repetition identifies the purified servants as the exception to the condemned company.

The immediately preceding false kinship claim is the speech from which 37:160 separates God's purified servants.

The same phrase appears in a counterfactual confession of the service that would have prevented disbelief.
The immediate continuation states that the addressed worshippers cannot tempt anyone except those destined for Hell.
Exclusive worship of God supplies the allegiance that distinguishes purified servants from false worship.
